question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: A single GET of the Help Center article search endpoint on support.optimizely.com, query 'billing', per_page 3. No credential, no cookie jar. A second request in the same transcript searched 'plan options and costs'.

decoded.result: count 164 for the query 'billing', three results returned, each with title, html_url and the article's full body HTML, including "Manage your account's plan and invoices" and "Usage and billing dashboards"
decoded.why-it-matters-here: every surface this entry measures refuses a stranger with 401, so this is the only route by which an agent with no Optimizely account reaches the vendor's own account-administration documentation, and it is how the billing evidence in version 4 of this entry was located
decoded.second-instance: the same endpoint on the same day answered the same way on support.zendesk.com (p-20260924-zendesk-keyless-hc-search), so this is the Zendesk help-centre product's documented anonymous end-user permission rather than one operator's misconfiguration; that record listed 'whether any other instance allows it' as not measured, and this one measures it
decoded.not-measured: anything behind an Optimizely credential; whether an instance can turn this off; whether the rate limit is per IP or per instance

finding: An agent with no Optimizely account, no key and no cookie can search Optimizely's support help centre through the Zendesk REST API it runs on and receive whole articles: 164 matches for 'billing', including the vendor's own account-administration pages. It changes nothing about access to the product, which answers 401 on both the MCP server and the REST API, and it is a documented anonymous permission of the help-centre software rather than a lapse. What it establishes is that for a vendor whose every product surface refuses a stranger, the documentation of how that vendor bills is machine-readable to one, and that the same permission holds on a second, unrelated Zendesk instance measured the same day.
